prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1353; do not mention it.)
text: The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was sideswiped during a lane change. Initial evaluation documented headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and intermittent nausea consistent with concussion. Neurological screening showed no focal deficits, and cognitive screening identified mild difficulty with concentration and processing speed. Activity modification and graded symptom monitoring were initiated, with strict limits on screen time and strenuous exertion during the acute phase. Over the course of 19 visits, care included vestibular and oculomotor rehabilitation, cervical spine treatment for associated neck pain, and gradual reintroduction of cognitive and physical activity as tolerated. Symptoms improved steadily, with headaches becoming less frequent and dizziness resolving with exercise progression. At the most recent visit, the patient reported near-baseline function, tolerating full work duties with minimal residual symptoms. Ongoing self-management guidance was provided, and the patient was advised to return promptly should symptoms recur or worsen.
